reason: The sachets are the point for me: I forget bottles at home and travel a lot, so a pre-counted day I can toss in my bag is easy. At $24.99 with money back if I finish the box, one try is low risk.
objection: Two capsules every day is still two capsules, and I already have a drawer full of half-used bottles. I worry this box ends up there too after two weeks.
would_change_my_mind: If it were one capsule per sachet instead of two, or if I could try a smaller starter pack before committing to 30 days.
